violations.text: Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the coffee service area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Staff informed to obtain soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026
Handwashing sink in the kitchen was lacking proper signage. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (panini press) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black during this inspection. PIC to call for service. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200-400 ppm. PIC adjusted to remove air pockets from dispenser tube. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals (hand washing soap at the bar) taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of staff, noodles were placed hot in the walk-in refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Staff placed on sheet pans to rapidly chill. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was 0 parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for quaternary ammonium sanitizer is 200-400 ppm. PIC informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Utensils and crocks were brought to be cleaned and sanitized. Staff informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. Inspector provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025
Hand-washing sink at the bar is lacking proper signage. New Violation. Correct By: 04/29/2025

Portioned roast beef was observed held at 42-48 degrees Fahrenheit, above the fill line in the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC removed overflow and placed in another container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

Ambient temperature of the coffee low boy was observed held at 48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All items requiring refrigeration were moved to other units. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025
Ice scoop was stored in contact with ice in the coffee station ice bin. Scoop handle was removed from the ice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machines. Inspector provided during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025

The presence of small flies is not controlled as evidenced by live insects observed during inspection. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 01/04/2024
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machines in the front service area and in kitchen. New Violation. Correct By: 01/18/2024
